cards.text: 01 Map commercial prompts Prioritize the questions that reveal real category, comparison, and use-case demand for Folloze—not vanity traffic.
02 Strengthen owned answers Revise and build pages that explain Folloze’s position in language both buyers and answer engines can understand.
03 Influence the source network Earn the publisher, community, review, and expert mentions AI systems use to corroborate a category answer.
04 Measure movement Track visibility, citations, referred demand, and pipeline contribution—then use the signal to choose the next prompt.
01 Find the prompts Separate offensive category opportunities from defensive brand and comparison questions.
02 Fix what exists Improve pages already close to ranking or earning citations before creating more.
03 Build what is missing Create owned assets that answer commercially meaningful questions with real depth.
04 Earn outside validation Influence publishers, communities, reviews, video, and expert sources used in AI answers.
05 Measure the channel Connect prompt visibility and citations to inbound and pipeline—not just rankings.
DAYS 01–15 Establish Folloze’s answer baseline Map priority category, use-case, and comparison prompts; record current citations, competitors, source patterns, and gaps.
DAYS 16–30 Choose the first answer territory Score opportunities by commercial intent, authority needed, content readiness, and strategic fit with Folloze’s build–activate–signal story.
DAYS 31–60 Improve owned content and close priority gaps Revise high-potential pages, create the missing answer assets, and align internal subject-matter expertise to the prompt set.
DAYS 61–90 Build corroboration and measure movement Activate the off-site source plan, monitor citation changes and referred demand, and use the findings to set the next quarterly roadmap.
